plots.title: Density vs exact
plots.explain: Row-averaged density along the tube at the final frame against the exact Riemann solution (Toro): left state (ρ, u, p) = (1, 0, 1), right (0.125, 0, 0.1), γ = 1.4, membrane at x = 0.5. From left: rarefaction fan, contact discontinuity, shock. The MUSCL/HLLC scheme smears the contact over a few cells; the mean absolute density error is 0.0014 at 810 cells (first-order at discontinuities).

plots.title: Velocity vs exact
plots.explain: Row-averaged velocity against the exact solution: the plateau between the rarefaction tail and the shock is the star-region velocity u* ≈ 0.927.

euler_sod.name: Sod Shock Tube
euler_sod.question: Where are the shock, the contact and the rarefaction, and how large is the error?

layers.title: The question
layers.text: Where are the shock, the contact and the rarefaction, and how large is the error?

layers.title: What the colours and motion show
layers.text: Two gases at different pressures separated by a membrane that bursts at t = 0. A shock runs into the low-pressure gas, a contact discontinuity follows it, and a rarefaction fan spreads the other way.

layers.title: One change to try
items: Raise the resolution and watch the mean density error fall.

layers.title: What to measure
layers.text: The density and velocity profiles against the exact Riemann solution and the printed errors.
more: Shorten the duration to see the waves before they spread.

layers.title: Physical explanation
layers.text: Sod's shock tube: a membrane separates high-pressure gas from low-pressure gas; when it bursts a shock runs right, a contact discontinuity follows, and a rarefaction fan spreads left. The exact Riemann solution is known, so this is the solver's quantitative check.

layers.title: Initial and boundary conditions (this preset)
layers.ic: Left state (ρ, u, p) = (1, 0, 1), right state (0.125, 0, 0.1), membrane at x = 0.5, gas at rest.
layers.bc: Zero-gradient ends (the waves have not reached them at the reference time 0.2).

layers.title: Numerical method, checks and limitations
layers.text: Same finite-volume scheme (MUSCL + minmod, HLLC, SSP-RK2, γ = 1.4) on a one-dimensional tube shown as a strip. Transmissive ends.
layers.checks: Analytical comparison: the exact Riemann solution (Toro). Measured mean absolute density error ≈ 0.003 at 300 cells (CI test).

layers.title: References
items: Toro, E.F. (2009). Riemann Solvers and Numerical Methods for Fluid Dynamics, 3rd ed. Springer (HLLC, exact Sod solution).

resolution.label: Resolution
resolution.help: Cells along the tube (the tube is one-dimensional; the strip is for display). Higher resolution sharpens the shock and contact discontinuity.

duration.label: Duration (×)
duration.help: Fraction of the reference time 0.2 (tube length 1); at 1.0 the waves have not yet reached the ends.

compare.text: Computed density and velocity against the exact Riemann solution, with mean absolute errors (in the diagnostics).
